title: Adrenal ultrasound
what: The doctor looks at the small glands above your kidneys with ultrasound. They are often checked together with the kidneys.
why: For high blood pressure in young people, changes in adrenal hormones, or if a growth was found on other scans.
duration: usually 15 to 20 minutes; the report is usually ready right away
tell_doctor: If changes were already found on CT or MRI. Bring the reports
If your blood pressure is high or jumps around

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually 6 to 8 hours without food. Still water is fine. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Gas
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 days before: less cabbage, beans, fizzy drinks, and dark rye bread.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own, especially blood pressure medicines.

bring: Past CT, MRI, and ultrasound results
steps: You lie on your back, then on your side
Gel is put on your belly and sides
The probe is placed under your ribs on the right and left
Sometimes you are asked to take a deep breath and hold it
feel: Cool gel and pressure from the probe under your ribs
Holding your breath for a few seconds may feel unusual
after: The report is usually ready right away
Small adrenal glands are not always easy to see on ultrasound. The doctor may order a CT or MRI

faq.q: Why couldn't the adrenal gland be seen?
faq.a: Normal adrenal glands are small and hide behind the ribs and bowel. It does not mean something is wrong with them.

faq.q: Which is better, ultrasound or CT of the adrenals?
faq.a: CT shows the adrenals more precisely. Ultrasound is a simple first step with no radiation. Your doctor decides what you need.

reminders.text: Adrenal ultrasound tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Still water is fine. No cabbage or fizzy drinks.
